environment.host_load: uncontrolled; no build/probe/capture/other agent game during FPS
environment.physical_controllers: disabled for automation only; previous maintainer confirmation not recertified

changes: EE owns halt state; host publishes atomic stop flag
Ordered final packet traverses EE/VU/renderer; VU stops after forwarding, renderer drains and waits GPU before ACK; EE dumps stats after ACK
Host owns VU thread, joins EE/VU, returns normally; early ELF/state errors also finish workers
Final forced pending-card flush; complete sibling pending file, checked close/replacement, dirty state cleared only after success; failed writes retain dirty data/retry
unchanged: FIFO normal packet order and queue atomic orders

tests.runtime_harness: actual VU worker and GS consumer, 256-byte queues, 4096 real GIF + present pairs in each full mode; VIF NOP packets on VU, terminal/final payload, empty queues, idempotent completion, join and atomic request
tests.card_harness: actual SIO2 command handler and filesystem;49/50 debounce, forced flush, blocked pending creation/replacement, old-card preservation, dirty retry, callbacks and reload

FPS_protocol.predeclared_acceptance: correctness fix needs no speed gain; no scene loses >3% in all three pairs

assessment_and_terminal_counters.terminal_stats_behavior_changed_by_desig: v16 drains VU/GS and final GPU batches before stats; v15 may omit tails

references.title: PCSX2 VMManager: pause transitions wait VU and GS
PCSX2 MTGS::ShutdownThread: shutdown flag, wake and join

limitations: No new FPS optimization or stable60FPS/full-game acceptance; small/adverse paired changes retained.
Final terminal totals intentionally include drained VU/GS/GPU work that v15 can omit. Counters do not establish complete asynchronous stream identity.
Matched callback prefix is500 samples after60, not scanout or physical latency; raw helper callback tails differ in coverage after drain and are retained.
Native/native synchronous image equality does not establish original PS2 fidelity.
Successful normal close and fixture persistence do not prove actual race-result save/readback, in-process restart, every failure path or power-loss durability.
Short Class1 checkpoint windows do not validate full races/classes2-4/Mirror/30minutes.
Original cadence/individual timing, real audio underruns, physical USB/Bluetooth latency and graphics parity remain open.
Minimal-PATH same-machine package boot is not second Windows/GPU, protected-folder or full Unicode game-IO acceptance.
Public GitHub remains documentary; private local package contains own ISO/ELF, and is not a public/friend alpha.
Historical v12/v14 regressions remain visible; Q v14 stays isolated.
